name: Local Keywords Manager
author: pluginsforall

sections.description:
Your local business targets a specific industry. In that industry there are specific local keywords that your business should target.

Your business also exist in a certain location. Your site content should target your industry specific keywords in your area.

Local Keywords Manager helps you find your industry specific keywords and create content that is targeted toward your service area.

Keyword Research

An API key is needed to use this plugin.
Get a free keywords account and api key at localruler.com

External services

This plugin connects to an API to obtain keyword data, its needed to show local keywords for specific industries.

It sends the industry selected by the user in the plugin to get industry specific local keywords from our server.

This service is provided by “localruler.com”: terms of use, privacy policy.

An API key is required to use this service.

short_description: An easy way to find local keywords for service areas surrounding your business and create posts and pages.
